facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 62°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 6 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Sonora Pass (8,770 ft) and Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) 7 to 13 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Sonora Pass
evidence.detail: left May 13; earlier seasons: June 25 (2023), May 26 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: July 30 (2023), June 21 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Sonora Pass (8,770 ft) and Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft).

evidence.name: Sonora Pass
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 57.9 in (2023), 24.9 in (2024), 23.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: 44.6 in on May 5; earlier seasons: 118.4 in (2023), 61.3 in (2024), 53.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 17 and July 13, carried from the melt-out dates at Sonora Pass (8,770 ft) and Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Sonora Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 13, 1,355 ft below the pass; points to May 5 to July 7

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 525 ft below the pass; points to May 29 to July 19
